postal_system.full_code_rule: Treat PC6 as a PostNL assignment to an address or number range. A polygon is separate evidence and must carry its own geometry authority.
postal_system.pc4_rule: PC4 is a coarse numeric area and cannot replace PC6 for an exact premise or building decision.
postal_system.cbs_geometry_rule: CBS/Esri PC4, PC5, and PC6 surfaces are versioned derived geometry with attribution, never official PostNL boundaries.
postal_system.model_geometry_rule: Voronoi, buffers, alpha shapes, learned boundaries, and AGID cell unions are candidate or virtual geometry only.

exception_classes.rule: Preserve even/odd number ranges and additions; do not replace them with a single centroid.
Pin year, corrected version, CBS and Esri attribution, and geometry method. Never label the surface as an official PostNL boundary.
Keep all BAG verblijfsobject-to-pand relationships and all public addresses; never collapse conflicting buildings into one result.
Retain Postbus and Antwoordnummer assignments as non-building postal records unless an independent public facility link exists.
Use separate valid and known times for postal, BAG, and geometry changes; do not overwrite history.

quality_gates.pass: Every source field has a pinned release, digest, terms or licence reference, attribution, and transformation method.
PostNL assignment, BAG address/building geometry, CBS/Esri postal geometry, and AGID indexing authority remain separate.
PC6, huisnummer, toevoeging, openbareruimte, and woonplaats agree on one BAG path; conflicts remain alternatives.
The corrected release and checksum are pinned and required CBS plus Esri Nederland attribution is emitted.
Geometry is valid, bounded, versioned, and overlap or gap changes are reported rather than silently repaired.
No occupant, recipient, phone, customer record, delivery instruction, API key, or private unit assertion is published.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with full lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
